name: orc_simple_r245fa
title: Simple ORC with imposed component performance (R245fa)
summary: Subcritical R245fa Organic Rankine Cycle for quick performance screening (Quoilin thesis Ch. 5.3): oil-heated evaporator, water-cooled condenser, recuperator, expander and pump with imposed effectivenesses and pinch constraints; computes pressures, state points, net power (14.8 kW) and cycle efficiency (15.7 %).

origin.course: PhD thesis (S. Quoilin, ULiège, 2011), Chapter 5.3 screening method

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file (CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip, EES_ok/orc_r245fa.EES, EES 9.920, 186 variables)
verification.notes: 88/177 common variables within 0.1 % (compare_solution.py rtol=0.001, max 5.2e-02 on k[6]); systematic 0.1-2.1 % deviations on the thermodynamic quantities traced to R245fa properties (EES $REFERENCE r245fa IIR vs CoolProp): saturation pressures +0.4-0.5 %, cp_vap_rec -1.75 %, Q_dot_rec -2.06 %, vapour conductivity k[6] -5.2 %. Derived results: W_dot_net -0.10 %, eta_cycle -0.27 %. x: EES stores 100 (superheated exhaust) vs CoolSolve 0 (diagnostic only). 9 stale EES-only variables from a commented-out block ignored. Shipped .initials required (oil-property block singular from default guesses).

related_external: CoolSolve examples/orc_r245fa.eescode (same model, kept in CoolSolve as a test case)
